examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the site places it: six customer quotes in a framed carousel, each with its client mark and signature, and one call to action under the tabs. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no items renders nothing at all.
examples.sfc:

  import herosparkExtendedColor from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/herospark-extended-color.svg'

      jobTitle: 'IT OPS, SRE & SEC Manager at Dafiti Group'
    },
    {

      text: 'With Azion, we scale proprietary AI models without managing infrastructure—inspecting millions of websites daily and automating the market’s fastest threat takedown.',

<template>

examples.name: Still
examples.summary: `autoplay` off holds one quote, and `v-model` (the selected index) opens the band on the second client. Use it when the page must not move or must lead with a given customer.
examples.sfc:
